reports.title: Graphic Packaging Holding Company Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Annual Guidance
section: The Company expects 2026 Net Sales, Adjusted EBITDA, and Adjusted EPS of approximately $8.6 billion, $1.05 billion, and $0.65, respectively.
The Company continues to expect 2026 Adjusted Cash Flow in the range of $600 million to $700 million, and 2026 capital spending below $450 million.
